value: à + person : poser une question à quelqu'un
à + person is replaced by an indirect object pronoun : je lui ai posé la question

evidence.notes: Source example 'Je lui ai posé la question plusieurs fois' shows the indirect pronoun; usage note states the person is introduced by à. Confidence high.

value: followed by the subjunctive
same-subject alternative : pour + infinitive

evidence.notes: Usage note states pour que requires an explicit subject and the subjunctive, while pour + infinitive is used with the same subject. Confidence high.

value: inversion : pourquoi venez-vous ?
answers are introduced by parce que

evidence.notes: Usage note states parce que is the usual conjunction in an answer; pourquoi is the interrogative form. Confidence high.

value: followed by the subjunctive
can be replaced by à condition que

evidence.notes: Usage note states pourvu que always introduces a subjunctive clause as a condition; à condition que is the standard equivalent. Confidence high.

value: followed by the subjunctive
used alone as an exclamation : pourvu qu'il y ait un cybercafé !

evidence.notes: Listed restriction states it is used as a single-clause exclamation; source example 'Pourvu qu'il y ait un cybercafé!' Confidence high.

value: no preposition between pouvoir and the infinitive
passé composé of pouvoir for a single past action : j'ai pu

evidence.notes: Source explanation states the passé composé of pouvoir is used when could refers to a single unique past action. Confidence high.

value: no preposition between pouvoir and the infinitive
négation : ne pas pouvoir + infinitif

evidence.notes: Source examples 'Elle ne peut pas venir aujourd'hui' and 'Est-ce que tu peux lui téléphoner?' show the bare infinitive and the negation. Confidence high.

value: indefinite plural des; an adjective can precede the noun : de longues vacances
négation : ne pas prendre de vacances (des → de)

evidence.notes: Source exercise 'Vous (prendre) de longues vacances' shows des + adjective; indefinite plural shifts to de in the negative. Confidence high.

value: definite article l' is fixed
passé composé with avoir : j'ai pris l'avion

evidence.notes: Source text 'j'ai pris l'avion' shows the fixed article and the avoir auxiliary. Confidence high.

value: definite article la is fixed
passé composé with avoir : a pris la fuite

evidence.notes: Fixed collocation with the definite article; prendre takes avoir in the passé composé. Confidence high.
